questions.question: What is the objective of the 'Sangathan-se-Samriddhi' scheme?
options: To provide better education facilities to rural children
To provide employment opportunities to rural youth
To empower rural women through Self Help Groups (SHGs)
questions.solution: Solution: The correct answer is  To empower rural women through Self Help Groups (SHGs) . In News   Government launches 'Sangathan-se-Samriddhi' scheme. Key Points The Government of India has launched a new scheme called 'Sangathan-se-Samriddhi' aimed at bringing marginalised rural women into the fold of Self Help Groups (SHGs). questions.question: The Ministry of Civil Aviation has launched which round of UDAN scheme in April 2023?
questions.solution: Solution: The correct answer is 5th . In News  Ministry of Civil Aviation launches UDAN 5.0. Key Points The Ministry of Civil Aviation has launched the 5th round of the Regional Connectivity Scheme (RCS) – Ude Desh Ka Aam Nagrik (UDAN). It will further enhance the connectivity to remote and regional areas of the country and achieve last mile connectivity. This round of UDAN focuses on Category-2 (20-80 seats) and Category-3 (>80 seats). Additional Information   About UDAN

questions.question: Which among the following is the correct expansion of 'NAMASTE' scheme?
options: National Action for Mechanized Sanitation Ecosystem
National Action for Maintaining Sanitation Ecosystem
National Action for Manual Sanitation Ecosystem
National Action for Maintaining Sanitation Environment
questions.solution: Solution: The correct answer is option 1. Key Points NAMASTE is National Action for Mechanized Sanitation Ecosystem. It was jointly launched by Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs and Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment in 2022. It aims to eradicate unsafe sewer and septic tank cleaning practices. questions.question: Which state government launched 'Ladli Bahna scheme' for women?
questions.solution: Solution: The correct answer is  Madhya Pradesh . In News Madhya Pradesh government launched Ladli Bahna scheme for women. Key Points Madhya Pradesh Government on 5 March 2023, launched the 'Ladli Bahna Scheme' to make women financially independent. The scheme aims to increase the economic independence of women in the state, improving their health and nutritional status. questions.question: What should be the monthly income to be eligible under the Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan?
questions.solution: Solution: The correct answer is below Rs 15000 . Key Points Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan is a voluntary and contributory Pension Scheme for Unorganized Workers aged 18 to 40 years with a monthly income of Rs.15000 or less. The worker should not be covered under any statutory social security schemes such as National Pension Scheme (NPS), Employees’ State Insurance Corporation scheme, or Employees’ Provident Fund Organization Scheme and is not an income tax payee.
